text:
carla (eng-platform): Heads up team 1: we're kicking off the regional runner split + GitHub org billing isolation project. Objective: put EMEA/APAC teams on local self-hosted runners (reduce egress and latency) and allow billing per org. Starting with a planning/runbook thread.

ben (devex): propose phased approach: 1) enable region labels and staging runner pools; 2) migrate infra/automation repos to new pools; 3) move repos/orgs and rotate tokens. keeps blast radius small.

nia (eng-sre): agree with phases. requirements from SRE: graceful drain tooling and a metric gate. suggested drain command: `./runnerctl drain --pool emea --timeout 10m` and a Prometheus check for `runner_jobs_active == 0` before decommission.

vik (eng-security): security notes: new orgs mean new GH App installations; we must schedule token rotation and update OIDC audiences. I'll draft a dependency checklist (secrets, webhooks, install ids). Also we should do a permission review on any repo moved.

alice (infra): infra constraints: some AMIs bake region-specific endpoints for metrics and SSM. I'll parameterize those in AMI build so same AMI can be used in eu-west-1/ap-southeast-1. Also need cross-account IAM role templates for runner instances per target org.

carla (eng-platform): early deliverables: devex to own a migration playbook + sample workflow changes, sres to own drain/runbook and metrics gating, security to own token rotation plan, infra to list AMI/IaC changes. target: draft plan shared by EOD next Thursday.

ben (devex): sample workflow snippet to opt-in:```yaml
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64, region-emea]
```
we'll provide a sed-friendly patch for teams to update quickly.

sam (product): will customers need notification if any latency-affecting infra changes land?

nia (eng-sre): not for the initial infra split. We'll surface to customers only if we change routing that affects end-user latency. We'll open a dashboard and alerting before any production cut.

vik (eng-security): high-level timeline for security work: create target orgs -> invite SSO groups -> install GH Apps -> rotate installation tokens day-of -> run permission audit within 48h. Some orgs may require legal/billing signoff; flagging now.

carla (eng-platform): webhook note: automation bots (deploy-bot, release-bot) will need their webhook URLs updated. @deploy-bot can you confirm the healthcheck endpoint?

deploy-bot: webhook-check: POST https://hooks.redwood.dev/ci-health -> 200 OK, payload {"ok":true}. Also supports verifying signatures via `X-Hub-Signature-256`.

alice (infra): cost accounting: ensure cost allocation tags are enforced on provisioning templates. we'll set default tags: team, org, cost-center. I'll add a policy in the provisioning pipeline.

ben (devex): adding a short section for teams that run long-lived caches: rsync migration steps, and a TTL-based cleanup plan. will also include a checklist for action-runner specific caches (docker layer shares).

carla (eng-platform): blockers?

vik (eng-security): blocker: two enterprise customers have dedicated billing contracts that require legal signoff before org creation. I'll coordinate with GTM and legal.

nia (eng-sre): noted. we'll add a contingency window in the rollout schedule for those cases.

carla (eng-platform): thanks all. I'll compile notes into the kickoff doc and post link in #eng-platform by EOD tomorrow, and schedule a 30m sync Monday 9am PT. Drop concerns here before then. :thumbsup:
